_comment: API contract registry. Grouped by app/lib. Updated by sdd-architect (status: defined) and sdd-implementor-back (status: implemented | updated). Source of truth for all endpoints.

endpoints.description: Returns the full list of active team members sorted by full_name ascending (case-insensitive). Feeds the giver/receiver selectors of the webapp.

responses.200: MemberDto[] — array of { id, full_name, handle }

endpoints.description: Returns the closed enum of categories with key (technical) and label (Spanish presentational). Backed by an in-memory constant; the frontend never hardcodes the list.

responses.200: CategoryDto[] — array of { key, label } for the six fixed categories

endpoints.description: Creates a kudo. Validates giver_id/receiver_id existence, giver != receiver, category in enum, message 1..280 code points after trim. Persists with server-assigned id and created_at (UTC). Rate-limited to 60 req/min per IP.

request_body.category: teamwork | ownership | innovation | delivery | kindness | learning

responses.201: KudoDto — expanded card with giver, receiver, category { key, label }, message, created_at

endpoints.description: Returns the paginated kudos feed ordered by (created_at DESC, id DESC). Cursor is opaque, HMAC-signed with CURSOR_SECRET. Default limit 20; values above 50 are silently capped.

query_params.limit: Optional. Default 20. Values above 50 are silently capped.
query_params.cursor: Optional. Opaque HMAC-signed cursor returned by the previous page. A corrupt cursor yields 400 INVALID_CURSOR.

responses.200: KudoListResponse — { items: KudoDto[], next_cursor: string | null }
responses.400: INVALID_CURSOR — cursor corrupt or from another database

endpoints.description: Liveness probe. Returns 200 with { status: 'ok' } while the service is up. No external dependencies.
